BrowserAllocation.purpose: base-image | artwork-image | encoded-blob | upload-staging | decoder-scratch | derived-uniforms | geometry-buffer

BrowserAllocation.apiLayoutDigest: Digest | null; canonical digest of the exact non-null layout
BrowserAllocation.state: acquiring | held | release-pending | released-owned; driven only by private owner transitions
BrowserAllocation.referenceIds: unique Id[] to complete BrowserReference rows
BrowserAllocation.fulfillsReservationId: Id | null; exact owned substitution, no simultaneous discount of unrelated row
BrowserAllocation.releaseReceiptId: Id | null, actual owner receipt required for released-owned

TextureLayout.levels: positive Count, exact complete allocated levels
TextureLayout.internalFormat: RGBA8 | SRGB8_ALPHA8 | RGBA32F; other formats explicitly unsupported initially

BrowserTotals.geometryOwnedCpuBytes: Count, exact supported public geometry format

BrowserLedger.preservedObjectsDigest: Digest under complete supported native-state predicate; includes actual index/drawRange/sampler/buffer/material state
BrowserLedger.references: BrowserReference[], complete and bounded by existing input/node limits

livePorts.captureSource: input complete document+original; return opaque BrowserSourceLease with immutable BrowserSourceCaptureV1 and live isCurrentBefore; source/history/epoch/owner mutation checks actual, not digest alone
livePorts.capacityOnly: input source lease+BrowserAppearancePlan@1; output BrowserCapacityBound@1 or structured refusal; no candidate/acquisition/ticket/write
livePorts.prepareAppearance: input source lease+BrowserAppearancePlan@1+BrowserCapacityBound@1+current callback+AbortSignal; bounded cancellable owned acquisition returning opaque preparation, no authority write
livePorts.admitAppearance: input exact source/preparation/plan; admit only original request's privately recorded additions/release proofs; preserve captured Expected and bind actual BrowserPreparedCaptureV1
livePorts.validateCommit: re-read actual source/current admitted scope, complete authority/floor/provider/resource/context identities and mutationEpoch around callbacks and finalCAS; foreign ABA refuses
livePorts.releaseUnadopted: input exact opaque preparation; owner-only candidate-specific logical release; false/unverified stays charged; unknown/possibly adopted refuses
livePorts.releaseReplacedAccepted: internal after known committed controlled activation and no history/pending/borrow refs; release exact old ownership only, cannot retire current accepted or replay effects
livePorts.retainUnknownAndRecover: existing session/journal/authority owns original-ID outcome; retain full resources and freeze; do not invoke command/prepare again to resolve uncertainty

pendingAttemptBudgetPort.status: PENDING review/freeze and actual paired implementation; not an existing public-kernel counter
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.owner: one composed Host-private actual per-attempt work/input/output meter or equivalent owner-enforced reservation/consumption capability
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.begin: before any source/history observation or copies; bind intrinsic attemptId,original request/source,accountingScope,profileDigest and fixed governing limits
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.phaseReservationInput: closed own data: phaseId,attemptId,accountingScope,profileDigest,budgetDomain,workUpperBound,inputUpperBoundBytes,outputUpperBoundBytes; interpreted only with actual owner-held capability
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.consumptionInput: closed own data: reservationId,phaseId,attemptId,workUnits,inputBytes,outputBytes plus the paired component's intrinsic observation capability; caller-supplied numeric claims alone refuse
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.phaseObservation: closed own data: attemptId,accountingScope,profileDigest,limitsDigest,mutationEpoch,phaseId,budgetDomain,spentWorkUnits,reservedWorkUnits,inputBytes,outputBytes,outstandingReservationIds; all counts nonnegative safe integers; data itself grants no budget/authority
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.budgetDomains: explicit frozen core-input/core-output/checkpoint/history/encoded-stream/decoded-capacity/native-upload domains and actual copy/work equations; apply unchanged applicable ceilings; do not silently equate pixel copies to command JSON or give each phase a new allowance
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.rules: charge before actual work or reserve a conservative owner-enforced bound before it; monotonic per-attempt counters within fixed domains; no phase reset/fresh nested budget; exact same capability across all phases; no caller reported chargedBefore/cost/ready flag substitutes for actual consumption; settlement requires paired actual evidence
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.refusals: missing/unbound meter; foreign/replayed reservation or attempt; changed request/source/profile/limits; exceeded work/input/output bounds; unobserved final-bind or real-WAL costs; overflow/nonfinite/accessor claims; no fabricated permission or zero-work success
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.authority: no operation/ticket/write permission; original Expected,current-context/resource/finalCAS remain independent and fresh
pendingAttemptBudgetPort.remainingDecision: joint Core/Artist/Editor must freeze exact domain equations and actual composable meter/reservation seams before any browser runtime advertisement; no new implementation is claimed
